description: Erection of building for data storage purposes (Class 4), Killellan Farm, Toward, Dunoon PA23 7UJ. Applicant Mr R Mitchell; agent Cliff Denovan, Dunoon. Local delegated decision; no EIA requested. This single-building permission is the only planning consent underpinning the marketed 'Killellan AI Growth Zone'.
decision_notes: Portal records 'Application Approved' and a permission expiry date of 15 May 2023; commencement subsequently certified as lawful under 25/00445/CLAWU. 6 public comments and 7 constraints are listed on the portal; contents not itemised here.

representations.notes: Portal shows 6 comments on the application; support/objection split not extracted.

description: Certificate of lawful use/development (existing): material operations in respect of lawful commencement of implementation of planning permission 20/00229/PP. Applicant Mr R Mitchell. Confirms works were begun so the 2020 permission has been implemented and cannot lapse — obtained days after submission, two months before the AI Growth Zone bid.

Main campus (100-600 MW / 2 GW+ on ~74 ha): NO planning application, proposal of application notice (PAN), EIA screening or scoping request located on the Argyll and Bute Public Access portal as of 30 July 2026. A portal search for the Killellan Farm address returns only 20/00229/PP and 25/00445/CLAWU. The developer's AI Growth Zone bid states that, upon designation, 'a comprehensive masterplan' would be submitted to the UK Government and Argyll and Bute Council — i.e. the developer itself confirms no masterplan application has yet been made.
decision_notes: Recorded to make the claims-vs-consent gap explicit; this is the largest such gap in the dataset.
